reference_resolution.rule: requirement_id must resolve to an actual ASVS clause; cwe, when present, must resolve to a real CWE identifier — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: level is cumulative per ASVS (L2 implies L1 coverage, L3 implies L1+L2); a role record's overall pass/fail is the worst-case verdict across all cited requirement_id checks at the record's declared level, never a standalone summary field (issue-515 invariant 4).
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

quality_bar.verification_method: checklist completion cross-reference against the declared ASVS target level's requirement list, every requirement checked off pass/fail
static scan for a validation call on each identified external input boundary (request body/query/header/file)
cross-reference the endpoint list against a declared authn/authz requirement per endpoint, including explicit "none, by design"
dependency vulnerability scan (e.g. npm audit / pip-audit or equivalent) on the diff's changed manifest, no critical/high CVE at the pinned version

use_when.board_condition: authentication or input-handling code landed on the branch AND no secure-coding record exists yet for that commit sha
